summary: Transaction 3524668 for $49.92 on card C09616-K1 was flagged by monitoring after the second-generation fraud model assigned it a score of 0.992 (calibrated historical fraud rate of 92.1%), despite a low legacy risk score of 0.30. Investigation revealed that card C09616-K1 was previously confirmed compromised in closed case CC-2294 following an unauthorized transaction in August 2016. Furthermore, the cardholder possesses no legitimate transaction baseline or recurring history on this card to support the charge. Although the transaction was an isolated charge from a generic device profile, unauthorized online activity on an already compromised card confirms card-not-present fraud. The transaction is deemed fraudulent, and the card has been blocked with an investigation case opened.
open_question: It remains uncertain whether this charge represents an unauthorized merchant retry on the old card credentials that slipped past authorization controls or a new online merchant compromise. Contacting cardholder C09616 to confirm they received their replacement card and ensuring card C09616-K1 is fully locked against all online authorizations would resolve this.
